scope: Representative exact-score mixture pilot, not full gate certification

acceptance.quality: Seed-mean finest metrics <= maximum independent target-control metric + predeclared practical margin; no degradation beyond that band

methods.initialization: Exact terminal mixture, not moment-matched Gaussian
methods.target: Clean mixture plus sigma0^2 Q smoothing, pulled back per arm
methods.coupling: Shared terminal particles and Brownian increments across modes; summed fine increments across grids; A L for full transport
methods.metrics: Common pulled-back coordinates; fixed shared target reference, 32 projections and independent target-pilot median kernel bandwidth
methods.streams: Separate terminal/Brownian, calibration, and score-check RNG streams
methods.uncertainty: Paired metric differences and SE across independent seeds; nested particle prefixes are not independent replicates

limitations: Does not clear the deterministic prerequisites or full transformation grid.
Empirical calibration bands are smoke-test acceptance, not formal equivalence intervals.
Finite-sample negative unbiased MMD squared is allowed.
Gaussian-moment KL is a proxy, not true mixture KL; modes may overlap.
Below-threshold naive target bias is measured, not required to vanish.
Particle refinement is reported, not required to be monotone.
No learned scores, approximate priors, or local re-clipping Arm A intervention.
